The '''House Trader's Circle''' was a marketplace on the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] situated at [[King's Pass]]. By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], this valley was a contested site where agents from the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] from [[House Rist]] disguised themselves as merchants to hide their operations.
